messages:
maya: Customer (Acme Mobile) reports repeated mid-stream disconnects during long SSE responses (~40-90s). They get a partial JSON object then the connection closes. Seen on Android hotspot -> cellular handoffs, ~30% of attempts. sample request_id: rc-7a9f2.
liam: Can we get the request_id and client logs? ask if they're using our SDK or a custom SSE client. Also: any proxies in path?
maya: Request_id above. They're on a custom client inside a Cordova wrapper (Android 11). They pasted a minimal repro cURL: 
````
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream -N
````
They say token TTL is 10m and request was <2m.
support-bot: Server logs for rc-7a9f2: 2026-03-10T14:12:03Z stream terminated: remote close (ECONNRESET). No server-side OOM or runtime crash. Proxy in front of customer region shows an idle timeout at 60s.
liam: That proxy idle timeout screams keepalive/heartbeat missing. If TCP idle >60s proxy may tear down during NAT/handovers. Ask for a tcpdump from the client around the event.
maya: Customer provided a short Android log snippet: TLS close_notify right after wifi->cell switch, then socket closed. They also included a timeline: start stream -> 35s keep quiet -> toggle hotspot off -> switch to cellular -> 2s later socket closed -> client reports partial frame.
eng-oncall: Two angles: client-side keepalive (application ping/comment events every 15-20s) and server-side recommendation (shorter chunk flushes so bytes flow while long generation runs). Also check whether token refresh logic closes the socket when fetching new creds.
maya: They confirm token refresh NOT happening mid-stream. They do have a corporate proxy between client and public internet for this site. Proxy idle kill + mobile NAT rebind during handoff is likely.
liam: Immediate workarounds we can propose: 1) add client SSE keepalive / send a comment line `: ping` every 20s, 2) enable periodic small flushes from our generator (if customer agrees) so there's network activity, 3) client reconnect with Last-Event-ID/resume logic.
customer-joe: We need a short-term fix — users are seeing truncated responses and retrying which doubles token usage. Can you suppress billing for retried partials while we investigate? :grimacing:
maya: Filing triage plan for customer: 1) Request tcpdump + Android logs for 3 examples; 2) Temporarily relax proxy idle timeout for their IP range (ops) or enable keepalive injection at edge; 3) Provide sample client code to send SSE comment pings; 4) Eng to evaluate safe resume semantics for partial outputs.
eng-oncall: I'll open INF ticket and assign to eng-runtime: INF-2026-43. Include server logs, proxy traces, and client repro steps. Priority: P2 for now.
liam: Also flag billing: if retries are client triggered due to network handoff we should consider a temporary credit for those requests. @finance please review S-9421 once linked.
support-bot: Created support ticket S-9421 and linked to INF-2026-43.
maya: Thanks — I'll send sample code snippet to customer and ask them to try a local patch that sends `: keepalive\n\n` every 20s. Will update thread after tcpdump arrives. :thumbsup:
